choice.why_saudi: A Saudi auction with an unexpected human detail: 18 trappers shared the capture of one bird, which sold for SAR300,000. Explain catching versus bidding clearly.
choice.why_now: Al Yaum reported the seventeenth auction night on November 4; the primary SPA report dates the auction to November 3, 2026.
choice.angle: Follow the Sharurah bird from a shared capture to bidding that opened at SAR80,000 and ended at SAR300,000, then explain the auction's narrow eligibility rather than imply every falcon is accepted. Use a strong relevant falcon photo without a visible illustrative-image disclaimer; this is conversational storytelling, not a news bulletin. Preserve source provenance internally and never claim the pictured bird is the auction bird.
choice.share_reason: An ordinary reader can retell how one bird involved 18 trappers and fetched SAR300,000; do not invent an equal division of the proceeds.

timing.reason: Fresh Al Yaum reporting of the seventeenth auction night. Primary SPA dates the underlying auction November 3, 2026; do not claim the sale occurred today.

story.point: The Sharurah bird involved 18 trappers; do not imply 18 bidders or invent individual proceeds.
